prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one beautiful magic mirror as a reusable prop for this project's cute glossy 3D fairy-tale underwater castle world. The attached image is STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY: match its rounded toy-like forms, pearl gold metal, shimmering pastel lavender, aqua and pink diamonds, shell motifs and warm welcoming magic. Do not reproduce the room or any character. Subject: a full-length oval standing magic mirror, elegant rounded gold frame studded with pearls and a few large faceted pastel gems, scallop-shell crest holding one heart-shaped lilac crystal, flowing symmetrical wave flourishes and a sturdy curved shell-shaped pedestal. Mirror glass is clearly reflective silvery pale blue with delicate iridescent lavender swirls and a few tiny magical star glints; no face or person in the mirror. Front-facing with slight three-quarter depth, complete object visible with generous clear margins, silhouette readable, polished high-quality children's fantasy animation rendering. Transparent background, no room, no text, no lettering, no watermark. Friendly, wondrous, not spooky. Keep ornament balanced so the broad oval mirror surface remains the visual focus.
